title: What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning?
lines: Earth just stopped spinning.
What if our planet suddenly stopped turning?
Right now, the ground at the equator is moving about a thousand miles an hour.
That's faster than the speed of sound.
Even in New York, you're moving almost eight hundred miles an hour.
You can't feel it, because everything moves with you.
But if the planet stopped, nothing on it would.
People, cars, trees and houses would keep flying east, up to a thousand miles an hour.
The air would keep going too, scouring the ground clean.
Near the equator, that's over three times the strongest tornado [winds](winds) ever measured.
The oceans would slosh east in giant tsunamis.
Only near the poles would you barely feel it.
Then it gets strange. One day would last a whole year.
Six months of sunlight, then six months of darkness.
The day side would bake. The night side would freeze.
Earth's magnetic shield might fade, letting in more radiation.
Right now, the spin makes the oceans bulge at the equator, about five miles high.
Without it, the water would flow to the poles, leaving one giant continent around the middle.
Earth is slowing down. The Moon's tides add almost two thousandths of a second to each day, every century.
One point four billion years ago, a day was only about eighteen hours.
